original_content_full:
The paper "Comparison of Deep-Learning Classification Approaches for Indoor Point Clouds" by Vladeta Stojanovic, Matthias Trapp, Rico Richter, and Jürgen Döllner has been accepted as a contribution to the 40. Wissenschaftlich-Technische Jahrestagung der DGPF at Stuttgart, Germany.

Link to the conference website: https://www.dgpf.de/con/jt2020.html
